info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account Node API
Returns node details by Node ID.

items.docs: Works only on Enterprise and Customer owned Nodes.

info.name: Returns the details of Enterprise Nodes within a Client or a Division.

params.name: statusId
params.description: Node status. “0” for Active; “1” for Inactive

params.name: networkType
params.description: Network Type (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration]). Accepted values: “3” for Enterprise (pt); “4” for Enterprise

items.docs: When no parameter is passed, all active node details are returned.

info.name: Returns the details of nodes of all network types based on parameters passed.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number to return records from when the number of records exceeds pageSize.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results that is returned per page. Maximum value is 100.

info.name: Returns the Node state, paused or not, based on the Node IDs passed.

items.docs: Works only on Enterprise and Customer owned Nodes.

info.name: Allows to pause or resume an existing node.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise and Customer owned Nodes.
            
To get payload for updating a Node State refer InternalLink[Node State Endpoint,operations-tag-Node,operations-Node-get_v2_nodes_state__nodeIds_]. State ID values – “0” for Resume; “1” for Pause. There can be multiple nodes in the payload for which the state update is intended.

info.name: Returns the Node status, active or inactive, based on the Node IDs passed.

items.docs: Works on Enterprise Nodes and Customer owned Nodes.

info.name: Allows to set the status of an existing node to Active or Inactive.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise and Customer owned Nodes.
            
To get payload for updating a Node Status refer InternalLink[Node Status Endpoint,operations-tag-Node,operations-Node-get_v2_nodes_status__nodeIds_] Endpoint. Status ID values – “0” for Active; “1” for Inactive. There can be multiple nodes in the payload for which the status update is intended.

info.name: Update properties of an existing node.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the updated object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return the updated object ID.

items.docs:
Works only on Enterprise and Customer owned Nodes.
            
**Request:**
            
Only the property to be updated can be passed in the request body instead of the whole object. The update request body requires a total of three keys to be filled with appropriate value as listed below:
* **value** – The value property provides the new value.
            
* **path** – The path property indicates the element to update. The entire path with slashes needs to be provided here. Example: /
